opening.title: Opening stock
opening.text: Record what’s already on your shelves when you start using Vendora.
opening.errorText: Check your connection and try again.
opening.emptyText: Turn on Track inventory for a product, then come back to count it.
opening.productHint: Only products that track inventory are listed.
opening.quantityHintWhole: More than 0. Whole numbers only — this unit can’t be split.
opening.quantityHintFraction: More than 0. Decimals like 0.5 are allowed.
opening.lowStockHint: Warn when stock falls to this number. 0 turns warnings off.
opening.crateText: First count for this branch. Later changes are stock adjustments, not opening stock.
opening.fixOne: Fix 1 field to continue. Everything you typed is kept.
opening.fixMany: Fix {{count}} fields to continue. Everything you typed is kept.

errors.whole: Use a whole number — this unit can’t be split.
errors.alreadyCounted: {{item}} already has opening stock at {{branch}}. To change it, use a stock adjustment.
errors.failed: We couldn’t save the opening stock. Check your connection and try again.

slip.title: Opening stock slip
slip.note: This sets the starting quantity. To correct stock later, use a stock adjustment instead.

opening.savedText: {{quantity}} {{unit}} of {{item}} are now on hand at {{branch}}.
